All data in this hub is derived from 24,650 unique engine replacement quote requests processed through EnginesMarket.co.uk and EngineFinders.co.uk during 2025. Requests are from UK vehicle owners seeking replacement engines. Data is anonymised and aggregated. Where external data is cited, it is labelled [THIRD-PARTY] . Where proprietary data is used, it is labelled [EM-VERIFIED] .
